captions.detailed: A 3D model of a communications blimp (airship) featuring a light grey, cigar-shaped envelope with a pointed tail. Suspended beneath the envelope is a dark grey rectangular equipment gondola equipped with side-mounted engine pods and a small rear mooring wheel. The tail assembly consists of four orange control fins: a top vertical stabilizer, a bottom vertical stabilizer, and two horizontal stabilizers. The two side propellers are designed to spin continuously, the rear wheel rotates on its axle, and the tail control surfaces (rudders and elevators) pivot on their respective hinges.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a communications airship with a light grey cigar-shaped main envelope, a dark grey rectangular gondola suspended underneath, side engine pods with spin-capable propellers, and a four-fin orange tail assembly with functional control hinges. Include a small mooring wheel on a support fork at the rear of the cabin.
captions.factory: The code constructs the airship by defining several parts. The main envelope is generated using a loft or revolution of a custom profile to create the cigar shape. The gondola is built from a box primitive, positioned below the envelope. The tail fins are modeled using angled box or wedge primitives, placed at 90-degree intervals around the tail. Propellers and wheels are constructed from cylinder primitives and attached via continuous or revolute joint definitions to represent their spin and hinge capabilities.
